description: This script is used to verify that all references to 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/<subpath>' modules in a TypeScript project are correctly exported in package files and entrypoints. It scans source files, parses module import specifiers, compares them against package exports and entrypoints, and reports violations if any referenced subpath is missing from exports or entrypoints.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads 'package.json' and returns a set of exported subpaths starting with './plugin-sdk/'

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads 'plugin-sdk-entrypoints.json' and returns a set of entrypoint subpaths excluding 'index'

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Extracts the subpath from a module specifier if it starts with 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/'

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares violation entries for sorting based on file, line, kind, specifier, and subpath

methods.name: collectViolations
methods.description: Collects and returns a sorted list of violations where referenced plugin SDK subpaths are not exported

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that executes violation collection and outputs results or errors
